value.rationale: The natural critical predator-invasion equality is missed by the source strict stability lemmas. A continuum of fractional competition exponents has a universal extinction clock and prey-deficit ratio; the mathematically sharp correction boundary \(p=3/2\) distinguishes finite phase shift from log and power corrections, materially changing long-horizon approximation. This is not an arbitrary finite slice or parameter renaming.
